description: Casual conversation and direct answers.
Explain a concept or answer why/how questions.
Condense long material into a concise summary.
Teach a concept step by step with examples.
Translate text while preserving meaning and tone.
system structure, technical planning, migration, high-level design (mimari plan)
visual direction, UI concept, color palette, aesthetics, presentation ideas (renk, görsel, tasarım)
idea generation and alternatives (fikir, beyin fırtınası)
moving from one structure to another (taşıma, geçiş)
roadmap and decision planning (strateji, yol haritası)
Code correctness, logic errors, type errors, bugs, and coding style. Kodun doğru çalışması, hata ve stil incelemesi. Genel kod incelemesi; güvenlik ve performans dışı sorunlar.

Security vulnerabilities, attack surface, authentication, authorization, secrets, injection, XSS, CSRF, access control, data exposure. Güvenlik açığı, saldırı, yetkilendirme, kimlik doğrulama ve güvenlik riskleri.
Performance, speed, latency, memory, CPU, database queries, rendering, bottlenecks, scalability, optimization. Performans darboğazları, yavaşlık ve kaynak tüketimi.
Architecture review, system structure, module boundaries, layering, coupling, dependency direction, maintainability. Sistem mimarisini, katmanları ve bileşen ilişkilerini incele.
Software quality review, maintainability, consistency, readability, test coverage, duplication, technical debt. Kod kalitesi, sürdürülebilirlik, test kapsamı ve teknik borcu incele.
Make targeted code edits in place. (mevcut kodu düzenle, ufak değişiklik)
Create new code from the user request. (yeni kod üret, oluştur)
Restructure code while preserving behavior. (refactor et, iyileştir)
Repair bugs or apply small corrective changes. (hata düzelt, fix)
Write or update tests. (test yaz)
Suggest visual design choices such as colors, typography, and layout options.
Suggest implementation approaches, patterns, or architectural options.
Suggest libraries, frameworks, tools, or technology choices.
Suggest UI/UX design alternatives and trade-offs.
